# Instituto Dental Lucrecia Botella

> A comprehensive dental clinic in Torrevieja, Spain offering specialized treatments from implants and orthodontics to proprioceptive dentistry and orofacial pain management.

Instituto Dental Lucrecia Botella is a modern dental practice in Torrevieja, Alicante led by Dr. Lucrecia Botella and her team including Dr. Macarena Botella and Dr. Alberto Pomares. The clinic combines traditional dentistry with innovative approaches like proprioceptive odontology and CAD-CAM implant technology.

## Key Topics

- Dental Implants
- Orthodontics (Invisalign)
- Aesthetic Dentistry
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Proprioceptive Odontology
- Periodontics
- Orofacial Pain Management
- Dental Prosthetics
- FirstFit Veneers
- CAD-CAM Technology
- Torrevieja
- Dr. Lucrecia Botella
- Dr. Macarena Botella
- Tooth Restoration
- Temporomandibular Disorders

## Core Services

- [Servicios Clínicos Dentales En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/servicios-clinicos-dentales): Overview of clinical dental services including implants, orthodontics, and aesthetics
- [Implantes Dentales En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/implantes-dentales-torrevieja): Dental implants using CAD-CAM technology for tooth restoration
- [Ortodoncia En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/ortodoncia-torrevieja): Orthodontic treatments including Invisalign Diamond II provider services
- [Estética Dental En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/estetica-dental-en-torrevieja): Aesthetic dentistry including whitening, veneers, and zirconia crowns
- [Odontología General](https://lucreciabotella.com/odontologia-general-torrevieja): General dentistry services covering fillings, root canals, and tooth extraction

## Specialized Treatments

- [Odontología Propioceptiva](https://lucreciabotella.com/posturologia-en-torrevieja): Proprioceptive dentistry and posturology treatments by Dra. Macarena Botella
- [Migrañas Y Dolor Orofacial](https://lucreciabotella.com/migranas-y-dolor-orofacial): Treatment for migraines, orofacial pain, and temporomandibular disorders
- [Periodoncia Biológica](https://lucreciabotella.com/periodoncia-torrevieja): Biological periodontics treatment for gum disease and periodontitis
- [Rehabilitación Protésica](https://lucreciabotella.com/protesis-dental-torrevieja): Dental prosthetics and rehabilitation restoring functionality and aesthetics
- [Odontopediatría En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/odontopediatria-torrevieja): Pediatric dentistry services for children's oral health and tooth restoration
